explanation: Store each entry with the maximum over its stack prefix. Popping immediately exposes the previous maximum. A newly constructed instance starts empty.
timeComplexity: O(1) amortized push and pop; O(1) empty, max and constructor.
spaceComplexity: O(n) for n entries, excluding allocator capacity slack.
attribution: JavaScript port of the independently authored EPI Practice C# algorithm; no upstream reference code copied.
